names: Basílica Catedral Metropolitana Santa María de la Encarnación Primada de América
mapIdentity.scope: Exact eight mapped footprint vertices and the two mapped enclosure walls. The 45.8 m rectangular nave, 54.6 m structural church length and octagonal presbytery follow the architectural survey. The 1899 north portal and clock stage and the 1915 plate of the older west front establish the two public elevations.

note: The published RTK survey gives the seven bays, the 9.63 m central nave, 4.80 m aisles and relationships among vault heights. The clock documented in 1899 survived until its later relocation. Roof pitches, chapter room alignment, rose opening detail and external chapel profiles are bounded estimates.
